svg.title: Substation technician — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as substation technician, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A finned transformer has two collared upper bushings beside a separate visibly open disconnect switch. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
